args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified as rolled out; monitoring to confirm health recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions; rollout verified.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.
